title: Whisperwood's Wonderful Voices
markdown:
The old oak tree rustled. "Whoooo," hooted the owl. "Whisperwood remembers a story about finding your own voice, like a songbird finding its tune."

Deep in Whisperwood, Rafe the fox opened a Public Speaking School. "Every creature," he announced, "deserves to be heard!"

His students were Pip the squirrel, who chattered fast; Barnaby the badger, whose words rumbled; and Cora the duck, who went slap-slap-slap.

Rafe taught them to stand tall. "Confidence," he boomed, "is the sparkle in your words!"

But learning got silly. Pip puffed out his chest to roar, but only a tiny squeak came out. Barnaby wobbled, trying to quack with his whole body. Cora flapped her wings, nearly sending berries rolling!

The next day, Pip whispered so softly, you had to sniff him to hear. Barnaby jigged while talking about roots, his paws tapping. Cora took a deep breath and rumbled, "ROOOOAR! The sky is blue!" A ladybug fell off a leaf. Whoooo could have guessed?

Aunt Vi, Cora's wise aunt, perched nearby. "They are trying," she told Rafe, her voice soft as moss. "But are they being themselves? It's like wearing boots too big for your feet."

Rafe thought. Pip was whispering loudly, Barnaby was hopping, and Cora was rumbling roars. Aunt Vi was right. "They're wearing someone else's confidence, not their own!" Rafe exclaimed.

Rafe gathered his students. "Forget roaring and wobbling!" he said gently. "Confidence isn't about being someone you're not. It's about letting the best you shine."

He told Pip, "Your chatter is like a sparkling stream!" To Barnaby, he said, "Your quiet thoughts are like strong oak roots!" And to Cora, "Your happy quacks are like a bright, sunny day!"

They tried again. Pip chattered with squirrelly excitement. Barnaby shared his thoughts calmly. Cora quacked her joy, wiggling happily. Rafe’s tail swished.

The forest seemed to sigh with relief. Each creature spoke with their own true confidence, a beautiful harmony. As the old ones say, the greatest confidence is being true to yourself. Whoooo wouldn't agree?
characters: Rafe the fox, Cora the duck, Aunt Vi
